name: RigoBlock Drago setMultipleAllowances missing owner check
summary: Drago v2 pools expose setMultipleAllowances(proxy, tokens, amounts) without the onlyOwner and whenApprovedProxy modifiers that guard setAllowance, so anyone can make a pool approve any spender. The attacker had the Pure Alpha Drago approve its contract for six tokens, which were then pulled and sold; a second actor did the same to the PayRue 1 Drago.
notes: The Drago is a factory-created full contract (no delegation), so its deployment is the reset. Approval logs of all 30 factory Dragos show only Uniswap router spenders before the anchor and none to third parties after, apart from the PayRue 1 approvals and the RigoBlock deployer's own rescue.

The Pure Alpha pull was sent by a generalized front-runner replaying the attacker contract's public drain function, which kept the ETH proceeds; the attacker's own copy reverted. The HBOT stayed in the attacker contract. Returns are not subtracted.
PayRue 1's aDAI is its balance drop including accrued interest; AMPL was pulled in a separate transaction.
